scope: One canonical dataset artifact per *.mock.json file. Entity specifications and sample records inside that artifact remain owned nested data, not independent Leafcutter native kinds or assertions about actual ACs, tests or components.

authorities.role: Complete native artifact schema: 15 top-level properties, five required, closed top-level and entity-envelope shapes but open sample record objects.
Canonical source discovery scans all mock-data/**/*.mock.json files, independently of manifest registration.
Validates all discovered datasets against the schema and invariant checks before checking index metadata.
Checks manifest entries against source status/readiness/version and entity vocabulary. It does not require every discovered dataset to have an artifacts entry.
Enforces one dataset per entity name per component. Do not silently collapse duplicates or merge records.
Authoritative registration manifest and derived lookup context; not the complete file-discovery set.

source_discovery.include: Recursively discover sorted *.mock.json files and emit one NativeRecord for each. Resolve every path within the supplied immutable repository root.
source_discovery.absent_directory: Return an empty list for an absent canonical store. Existing malformed JSON, non-object roots, missing/non-string/empty id, and duplicate dataset IDs are explicit errors, never silent skips.
source_discovery.manifest_behavior: If index.json exists, keep matching mock_data entry and its source locator in derived context without overwriting dataset metadata. An unlisted canonical file remains a dataset and has an explicit unregistered context. Missing optional manifest context does not erase datasets. Do not manufacture metadata fields from index defaults.
source_discovery.inventory_correction: inventory.json reports one manifest entry, which is correct for that count basis but incomplete for the canonical MockData population. Canonical file scan has two records in this checkout.

record_identity.native_id: Exact artifact id string, such as fern-and-fig/catalog; no slug normalization or derivation from a manifest title.
record_identity.source_path: Repository-relative POSIX path to the actual *.mock.json file.
record_identity.locator: Empty string: the entire JSON document is the canonical artifact.
record_identity.metadata: Deeply preserve the complete original parsed JSON object. Do not filter fields using today's schema, infer defaults, or replace entities with their names.
record_identity.title: The dataset schema has no title. A matching manifest title may supply only the presentation title, with its manifest origin explicitly retained in derived context; otherwise use an empty title or native identity per the shared presentation policy.
record_identity.description: The dataset schema has no summary/description. Matching manifest summary may supply presentation text only; preserve its context separately.
record_identity.derived: Suggested keys: manifest_entry, manifest_source_path, manifest_locator, manifest_registered. Any source diagnostics and presentation fallbacks belong here rather than in authored metadata.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Path-stable <product>/<name> identity; schema describes this convention but imposes no regex.

fields.name: component
fields.meaning: Product-truth component namespace. Preserve exact string; do not assume it equals the components.json snake_case registry vocabulary.

fields.name: superseded_by
fields.meaning: Replacement artifact identity; preserve explicit null independently of absence.

fields.name: shape_version
fields.meaning: Opt-in shape-bound version. Absence predates those bounds and must not be filled with a current/default version.

fields.name: example_product
fields.meaning: Explicit example-product marker, not an ownership source. Preserve absence and never synthesize from the artifact id or entity names.

fields.name: realization
fields.meaning: Origin classification. Schema describes absent semantic default built but ingestion must retain the authored omission rather than add built.

fields.name: invariants
fields.meaning: Authored rules and prose, not executable instructions to this importer or claims the importer has validated them.

fields.name: entities
fields.meaning: Owned field descriptions and sample records; retain arbitrary entity names exactly, with escaped JSON pointer keys.

fields.name: used_by
fields.meaning: Authored use references; not proof that a test executed or an implementation exists.

fields.name: provenance
fields.meaning: Ordered authoring history. Preserve each action/by/date/note tuple together by index.

nested_shapes.meaning: An authored type/description string, not a machine type validator. Never coerce sample values based on it.

Arbitrary sample JSON keys and recursively nested values, arrays, objects, strings, numbers, booleans and nulls. There is no universal required id key and no fixed per-entity key allowlist. Preserve order and correlation.

fields.date: string, with no schema format restriction

native_property_exposure.scalar_and_list: Expose all authored scalar and homogeneous scalar-array values through the shared property encoder, subject to protected graph-bookkeeping collision rules.
native_property_exposure.shape: Shape metadata must retain absent versus null versus empty containers, native JSON types, object keys, array ordering, and each sample-record index. Never stringify an entire nested record as the only exposure.
native_property_exposure.no_inference: Do not promote Plant, Customer, Ac, FrontendComponent or other nested entity specifications to native labels or actual repository records. Sample covered_by/declared_by/status values are dataset content, not real graph relationships or implementation evidence. Do not infer component registry membership from product-truth scalar component strings.
native_property_exposure.schema_drift: Today's schema disallows unknown envelope fields but the extractor must not discard future/legacy fields. Source validity checks and field preservation are separate: report/reject invalid input explicitly where required, never silently filter it into a valid-looking record.

required_test_cases: Discover both manifest-listed and unlisted canonical *.mock.json sources while excluding adjacent *.prompt.json fixtures.
Assert complete parsed metadata equality and shared encoder round-trip for all 15 fields, nested entities/field specs/records, typed numbers and booleans, nested arrays/maps, and provenance ordering.

Distinguish omitted optional values, explicit superseded_by/record-field null, empty used_by arrays, empty entities/spec fields and empty sample record lists. Do not apply realization or shape_version defaults.
Retain raw dataset fields when a manifest entry has different component/status/readiness/version/title/summary context; expose context separately and never merge it into the dataset.
Keep nested Ac records as owned sample data and verify no extra AcceptanceCriterion/Component/Test nodes are produced.
Reject unreadable/malformed JSON, invalid root/id, duplicate native identity and a discovered symlink or manifest reference escaping the immutable repository root, with a useful source path.
Use a process-local mutation that omits an unlisted dataset or drops a nested sample value to prove those field-coverage assertions fail, then restore and rerun.
